decision.summary: The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to a range of 2-3/4 percent.

changes.quote: The Federal Open Market Committee decided today to raise its target for the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 2-3/4 percent.
changes.explanation: The Fed lifted its target rate by 25 basis points to 2-3/4 percent.

changes.quote: Output evidently continues to grow at a solid pace despite the rise in energy prices, and labor market conditions continue to improve gradually.
changes.explanation: Economic output is now described as growing at a solid pace instead of a moderate pace.

changes.quote: Though longer-term inflation expectations remain well contained, pressures on inflation have picked up in recent months and pricing power is more evident.
changes.explanation: The Fed noted that inflation pressures have picked up and businesses have more pricing power.

changes.quote: The rise in energy prices, however, has not notably fed through to core consumer prices.
changes.explanation: A new sentence was added noting that higher energy prices have not significantly impacted core consumer prices.

changes.quote: With underlying inflation expected to be contained, the Committee believes that policy accommodation can be removed at a pace that is likely to be measured.
changes.explanation: The Fed updated its description of underlying inflation from relatively low to contained.

tone_quotes.quote: Though longer-term inflation expectations remain well contained, pressures on inflation have picked up in recent months and pricing power is more evident.
With underlying inflation expected to be contained, the Committee believes that policy accommodation can be removed at a pace that is likely to be measured.

for_you.text: On a $5,000 card balance at about 12.51% APR, a 25 bp increase raises monthly interest by about $1.04.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 4.63% and moved +10 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 5.85% would rise by about $19.20 a month.
High-yield savings rates usually follow the Fed partly; on $10,000 that means roughly $15.00 a year more in interest.
Unemployment was 5.4%, and employers added an average of 177k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 3.1% over the past year (February 2005); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 2.2%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 4.1% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved +14 bp on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that the Federal Reserve intends to keep raising interest rates at a measured pace. The educational forecast model assigns an 88% probability of another rate hike at the upcoming meeting.
